Product Features

- 3 Flame color options and 5 level variable flame speed

- Pulsating 10-color ember bed

- WiFi App (Alexa and Google Certified)

- Thermostat with auto-off overheat protection

- Built-in timer mode for shut off in 30 minutes to 7.5 hours.

- Remote control for heat and flame setting (batteries not included)

- Flame with heat – Heat no flames – Flames no heat

- Designed for recessed mounting in wall

- Slim frame that features a large fireplace viewing area with life-like LED flames that are unrivaled by competitors

- Heats up to 400 square feet (5,000 BTUs)

- Can be plugged in or hardwired 120V

GenStone versatile electric fireplaces offers two installation options. Although it is essentially designed for insertion in your wall, it can also be mounted on your wall. Instructions for mounting and install come with the fireplace, and we recommend you follow the simple instructions provided. We recommend placing your fireplace at least 20″ below your ceiling or 8″ below your mounted flat screen TV because of its heating feature.
